    n = data[0]

    l = data[2]
    r = data[3]
    sall = data[4]

    # Assign the maximum possible points to the top k students
    top_k_points = [r] * k
    remaining_points = sall - sum(top_k_points)

    remaining_students = n - k

    min_needed_for_remaining = remaining_students * min_points_per_student
    
    if remaining_points < min_needed_for_remaining:
        # If not enough points, adjust the top k students
        diff = min_needed_for_remaining - remaining_points
        for i in range(k):
            if top_k_points[i] > l:
                reduce_by = min(diff, top_k_points[i] - l)
                top_k_points[i] -= reduce_by
                diff -= reduce_by
                if diff == 0:
                    break
    
    remaining_points = sall - sum(top_k_points)
    
    # Distribute the remaining points among the rest of the students
    bottom_n_minus_k_points = [l] * remaining_students
    extra_points = remaining_points - sum(bottom_n_minus_k_points)
    
    # Distribute extra points if any
    for i in range(extra_points):
        bottom_n_minus_k_points[i % remaining_students] += 1
    
    # Combine the points
    result = top_k_points + bottom_n_minus_k_points
    
    # Print the result
    print(" ".join(map(str, result)))
